mots.exemple_en: I don't know where he is.
mots.exemple_fr: Je ne sais pas où il est.

indice.en: You say this when you have no answer to give

mots.exemple_en: Of course you can come.
mots.exemple_fr: Bien sûr que tu peux venir.

indice.en: You say this when something is completely clear to everyone

mots.exemple_en: There is a lot of work.
mots.exemple_fr: Il y a beaucoup de travail.

indice.en: You put this before a thing when there is a big quantity

mots.exemple_en: Is he coming? I think so.
mots.exemple_fr: Il vient ? Je crois que oui.

indice.en: You answer this when you believe something is true but are not certain

mots.exemple_en: Will it rain? I don't think so.
mots.exemple_fr: Il va pleuvoir ? Je ne crois pas.

indice.en: You answer this when you believe something is false, politely

mots.exemple_en: I'm not sure about the date.
mots.exemple_fr: Je ne suis pas sûr de la date.

indice.en: You say this when you have a doubt and do not want to answer wrong

mots.exemple_en: What do you mean by that?
mots.exemple_fr: Qu'est-ce que tu veux dire par là ?

indice.en: You ask this when you did not understand what someone just said

mots.exemple_en: It doesn't matter, we have time.
mots.exemple_fr: Ça n'a pas d'importance, on a le temps.

indice.en: You say this to stop someone from worrying about a small problem

mots.exemple_en: By the way, your brother called.
mots.exemple_fr: Au fait, ton frère a appelé.

indice.en: You put this before a new subject that just came to your mind

mots.exemple_en: She is busy at the moment.
mots.exemple_fr: Elle est occupée en ce moment.

indice.en: You add this to say a thing is true now but may change

mots.exemple_en: I'd like to see the room.
mots.exemple_fr: Je voudrais voir la chambre.

indice.en: You use this to ask for something in a polite way

mots.exemple_en: Send it as soon as possible.
mots.exemple_fr: Envoie-le dès que possible.

indice.en: You add this when a thing must be done with no delay

mots.exemple_en: Hello, how are you?
mots.exemple_fr: Bonjour, comment vas-tu ?

indice.en: You ask this at the start of a talk, to be polite

mots.exemple_en: Thank you very much for your help.
mots.exemple_fr: Merci beaucoup pour ton aide.

indice.en: You say this when someone has helped you a lot

mots.exemple_en: Thank you! You're welcome.
mots.exemple_fr: Merci ! De rien.

indice.en: You answer this when someone thanks you

mots.exemple_en: Excuse me, where is the station?
mots.exemple_fr: Excusez-moi, où est la gare ?

indice.en: You say this to stop a person you do not know and ask a question

mots.exemple_en: I'm sorry, it was my mistake.
mots.exemple_fr: Je suis désolé, c'était mon erreur.

indice.en: You say this when you have done something wrong

mots.exemple_en: Never mind, I will do it.
mots.exemple_fr: Ce n'est pas grave, je le ferai.

indice.en: You say this to close a small problem without talking more

mots.exemple_en: Is it on Monday? That's right.
mots.exemple_fr: C'est lundi ? C'est exact.

indice.en: You say this to confirm that someone is correct

mots.exemple_en: It rained. That's why we stayed.
mots.exemple_fr: Il a plu. C'est pour ça qu'on est restés.

indice.en: You put this before the reason of a thing you just said

mots.exemple_en: It looks hard. In fact it is easy.
mots.exemple_fr: Ça a l'air dur. En fait c'est facile.

indice.en: You add this to give the true situation, often against what was expected

mots.exemple_en: Take a fruit, for example an apple.
mots.exemple_fr: Prends un fruit, par exemple une pomme.

indice.en: You put this before one case that shows a general idea

mots.exemple_en: It depends on the weather.
mots.exemple_fr: Ça dépend du temps.

indice.en: You say this when the answer is not always the same

mots.exemple_en: I agree with you on that.
mots.exemple_fr: Je suis d'accord avec toi là-dessus.

indice.en: You say this when you think the same thing as someone

mots.exemple_en: Where is he? I have no idea.
mots.exemple_fr: Où est-il ? Je n'en ai aucune idée.

indice.en: You say this when you know nothing at all about a question

mots.exemple_en: Let me know when you arrive.
mots.exemple_fr: Tiens-moi au courant quand tu arrives.

indice.en: You say this to ask for the answer later

mots.exemple_en: Can you help me with this?
mots.exemple_fr: Peux-tu m'aider avec ça ?

indice.en: You ask this when a problem is too difficult alone

mots.exemple_en: How much is it for two?
mots.exemple_fr: Combien ça coûte pour deux ?

indice.en: You ask this in a shop to know the price

mots.exemple_en: How long does it take by car?
mots.exemple_fr: Ça prend combien de temps en voiture ?

indice.en: You ask this to know the time a thing needs

mots.exemple_en: Excuse me, what time is it?
mots.exemple_fr: Excusez-moi, quelle heure est-il ?

indice.en: You ask this to know the hour of the day

mots.exemple_en: The trip is in June. I'm looking forward to it.
mots.exemple_fr: Le voyage est en juin. J'ai hâte.

indice.en: You say this when you want a thing to come and it makes you happy

mots.litteral: Je regarde en avant vers ça

mots.exemple_en: Do you mind if I open the window?
mots.exemple_fr: Ça te dérange si j'ouvre la fenêtre ?

indice.en: You put this before an action to ask a polite permission

mots.exemple_en: Do you want to speak? I'd rather not.
mots.exemple_fr: Tu veux parler ? Je préfère pas.

indice.en: You say this to refuse without giving a reason

mots.exemple_en: Tea or coffee? It's up to you.
mots.exemple_fr: Thé ou café ? C'est toi qui vois.

indice.en: You say this to leave the choice to another person

mots.exemple_en: Take your time, we are early.
mots.exemple_fr: Prends ton temps, on est en avance.

indice.en: You say this to stop someone from going too fast

mots.exemple_en: Hold on a minute, I am coming.
mots.exemple_fr: Attends une minute, j'arrive.

indice.en: You say this to ask for a short wait

mots.exemple_en: I have to go. See you later.
mots.exemple_fr: Je dois y aller. À plus tard.

indice.en: You say this when you leave and will meet the person again

mots.exemple_en: Come on, we are late.
mots.exemple_fr: Allez, on est en retard.

indice.en: You say this to push someone to move or to try

mots.exemple_en: Be careful, the floor is wet.
mots.exemple_fr: Fais attention, le sol est mouillé.

indice.en: You say this to warn someone of a danger

mots.exemple_en: Watch out, a car!
mots.exemple_fr: Attention, une voiture !

indice.en: You shout this when a danger is very near

mots.exemple_en: Let's eat outside. That's a good idea.
mots.exemple_fr: Mangeons dehors. C'est une bonne idée.

indice.en: You say this to accept what someone just offered

mots.exemple_en: She won! I can't believe it.
mots.exemple_fr: Elle a gagné ! Je n'y crois pas.

indice.en: You say this when a thing is too strange to be true

mots.exemple_en: It's not my fault, the train was late.
mots.exemple_fr: Ce n'est pas ma faute, le train était en retard.

indice.en: You say this to refuse the problem as yours

mots.exemple_en: There is noise outside. What's going on?
mots.exemple_fr: Il y a du bruit dehors. Qu'est-ce qui se passe ?

indice.en: You ask this when you see a strange situation

mots.exemple_en: Now it makes sense to me.
mots.exemple_fr: Maintenant ça se tient pour moi.

indice.en: You say this when an idea is clear and right

mots.exemple_en: It costs ten euros, more or less.
mots.exemple_fr: Ça coûte dix euros, plus ou moins.

indice.en: You add this when a number is near but not exact

mots.exemple_en: Wait at least ten minutes.
mots.exemple_fr: Attends au moins dix minutes.

indice.en: You put this before the smallest quantity that is certain

mots.exemple_en: She came, and her brother as well.
mots.exemple_fr: Elle est venue, et son frère aussi.

indice.en: You put this at the end to add one more thing

mots.exemple_en: So far the work is going well.
mots.exemple_fr: Jusqu'ici le travail avance bien.

indice.en: You add this to say what is true up to now

mots.exemple_en: I need it right now.
mots.exemple_fr: J'en ai besoin tout de suite.

indice.en: You add this when a thing must be done at this moment
